name: Hydroid Krasis
oracle_text:
When you cast this spell, you gain half X life and draw half X cards. Round down each time.
Flying, trample
This creature enters with X +1/+1 counters on it.
blocked_sentences: When you cast this spell, you gain half X life and draw half X cards. Round down each time.

needs.what: a cast trigger (`spell_cast`, `source: self`, `active_zones: ["stack"]`) whose effects can read the X the spell was cast with via `{"x": true}` (then `half`, rounded down) -- the SPELL_CAST event fired by `Game._cast` must carry `x=item.x` and `x` must be in `triggers.EVENT_BINDING_KEYS` (or `event_bindings` must read the stack item's X) so it overrides the object's `cast_x`
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `event_bindings` sets the trigger's `x` from `obj.cast_x`, which `stack.resolve` writes only when the spell resolves; the SPELL_CAST payload in `Game._cast` has no `x`, so a cast trigger reads X as 0 and gains/draws nothing. `half` of (`mana_value_of` self minus 2) would read mana value rather than the printed X and is a stand-in, not the referent
